import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, list_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Run inside the workbench's Docker application runner."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, delete_expense, list_expenses, summarize_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    commands.add_parser('report')
    delete = commands.add_parser('delete')
    delete.add_argument('--id', required=True, type=int)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    elif args.command == 'report':
        result = summarize_expenses(entries)
    elif args.command == 'delete':
        entries = delete_expense(entries, args.id)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = {'deleted_id': args.id, 'remaining_count': len(entries)}
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    def test_delete_middle_keeps_order_and_fields(self):
        entries = [

            {'id': 2, 'title': 'Bus', 'cents': 300, 'category': 'transport', 'note': 'keep'},

        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'Lunch', 'cents': 1200, 'category': 'food'},
            {'id': 3, 'title': 'Book', 'cents': 500, 'category': 'study'},
        ])

    def test_delete_does_not_mutate_input(self):
        entries = [
            {'id': 1, 'title': 'Lunch', 'cents': 1200, 'category': 'food'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'Bus', 'cents': 300, 'category': 'transport'},
        ]
        call('ledger', 'delete_expense', entries, 1)

            {'id': 1, 'title': 'Lunch', 'cents': 1200, 'category': 'food'},
            {'id': 2, 'title': 'Bus', 'cents': 300, 'category': 'transport'},
        ])

    def test_delete_only_entry(self):

            call('ledger', 'delete_expense', entries, 999)

"""Run inside the workbench's Docker application runner."""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

from ledger import add_expense, list_expenses, summarize_expenses


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='A small persistent expense ledger')
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    add = commands.add_parser('add')
    add.add_argument('--title', required=True)
    add.add_argument('--cents', required=True, type=int)
    add.add_argument('--category', required=True)
    commands.add_parser('list')
    commands.add_parser('report')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(os.environ.get('AGENTFORGE_DATA_DIR', '.')) / 'expenses.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else []
    if args.command == 'add':
        entries = add_expense(entries, args.title, args.cents, args.category)
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
        result = entries[-1]
    elif args.command == 'report':
        result = summarize_expenses(entries)
    else:
        result = list_expenses(entries)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
